headline: Design-system foundation for the storefront
summary: The default theme's layout shell is rebuilt around a published token system. Operators forking the storefront now compose against CSS custom properties for palette, typography, spacing, radius, shadow, and motion — page renderers no longer redeclare values inline. The header gains a search form and the layout ships a brand-tinted footer.

items.title: Storefront `LAYOUT` exposes a CSS token system
items.body: `:root` now declares the palette (`--ink`, `--ink-2`, `--mute`, `--hair`, `--paper`, `--bg`, `--accent`, `--accent-d`, `--accent-l`, `--danger`), a typography scale (`--font-display`, `--font-body`, `--font-mono`, `--text-xs` through `--text-3xl`, `--lh-tight`/`--lh-snug`/`--lh-body`), a 4px-base spacing scale (`--space-0` through `--space-8`), radius tokens (`--radius-sm`/`--radius-md`/`--radius-lg`/`--radius-pill`), shadow tokens (`--shadow-sm`/`--shadow-md`/`--shadow-lg`), and motion tokens (`--ease-out`, `--duration-fast`, `--duration-mid`). Forks override at `:root` instead of patching individual rules.

items.title: Header gains a search form
items.body: The sticky header now renders a `GET /search` form alongside the brand and cart pill (`<input type="search" name="q">`). The form posts to a route the catalog primitive will own; until that route lands the search button returns a `Not found` page. Mobile breakpoint wraps the search input onto its own row.

items.title: Site footer
items.body: Layout ships a brand-tinted footer carrying the shop name, a one-line tagline ("server-rendered HTML, zero npm runtime dependencies, security defaults on"), a primitive list (Built on blamejs · Server-rendered · PQC-first), and a copyright with the current UTC year. The wrapper layout adds a flexbox column on `<body>` so the footer pins to the viewport bottom on short pages.

items.title: Accessibility + motion defaults
items.body: Layout reset adds a skip-link to `#main`, `:focus-visible` outlines (2px accent, 2px offset) on every interactive element, ARIA labels on the cart pill + primary nav, and wraps every transition behind `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`. Price + total cells render in `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so column alignment holds across digit widths.

items.title: Shared building-block classes
items.body: The layout `<style>` block defines `.grid`, `.card`, `.btn`, `.btn-secondary`, `.summary-table`, `.empty`, `.price`, `.total`, `.cart-pill`, and `.hero` against the new tokens so per-page renderers (home / product / cart / checkout / pay / order) compose them instead of redeclaring colors + spacing.

items.title: Layer 1 — `storefront._layoutTokens`
items.body: `test/layer-1-state/storefront.test.js` gains an assertion cluster that pins every required CSS custom property (palette, typography scale, spacing scale, radius, shadow, motion), the reset + a11y hooks (`box-sizing`, `:focus-visible`, `prefers-reduced-motion`, `tabular-nums`, `id="main"`), the shared classes (`.grid`/`.card`/`.btn`/`.btn-secondary`/`.summary-table`/`.empty`/`.cart-pill`/`.hero`), the search form shape (`action="/search"`, `method="get"`, `name="q"`, `type="search"`), and the footer (primitive list + copyright).
